main_dirt.bias_notes: Left-handed (Anti-clockwise). An exceptionally tight 1,200m oval featuring severe, sharp corners and a short 300-metre straight run-in. Generates one of the most punishing inside-barrier and on-pace biases in Japanese NAR racing. Front-runners ('E') and box-seat rail-skimmers ('P') hold an immense structural advantage. Closers face brutal traffic and ground loss on the turns.
main_dirt.post_bias: In the hyper-extended 900m sprints, Stalls 1 through 4 hold an overwhelming statistical edge due to a tiny run-in to the first turn. In 1400m and 1600m events, inside draws saving ground remain critical. Avoid wide draws (9+) unless the runner possesses unmatched early gate speed to clear the field.

handicapping_angles.extreme_tight_corner_leader_lock: Kawasaki is a pure 'Leader-Lock' bullring layout. Heavily upgrade horses with confirmed early speed ('E') drawn inside. Automatically downgrade deep backmarkers ('C' / 'Swoopers') who require long, grinding stretches to build momentum.
handicapping_angles.the_900m_chute_gate_speed_filter: The 900m sprint is entirely decided in the first 100 metres. Identify inside-drawn speed metrics. If the model flags a horse with a rating gap and an 'E' running style in an inside stall, treat it as a high-confidence anchor play.
handicapping_angles.wet_sand_kickback_factor: On wet, muddy, or sloppy tracks, the sand packs hard and turns into a lightning-fast speed strip. Trailing horses swallow intense sand kickback off the tight turns, causing many to drop the bit. Upgrade the lone speed aggressively on wet days.
handicapping_angles.jra_vs_nar_exchange_class_spike: During major exchange stakes (e.g., Kawasaki K記念, Zen-Nippon Nisai Yushun), Tier 1 elite JRA central shippers invade the NAR circuit. Pure JRA class and speed par offsets completely dominate local NAR provincial form lines, rendering barrier penalties secondary.
handicapping_angles.apprentice_claim_weight_relief: In standard NAR ratings benchmarks, effective weight relief via apprentice claims (1kg-3kg) is a massive length-saver around Kawasaki's continuous turning layout. Grant a boost to fit speed types carrying low effective weight.
